name: OG Lethal Ape Redux
summary:
# OG Lethal Ape Redux

A fast-paced, actively developed physics-based horror experience.

Overview

OG Lethal Ape Redux is the original movement-driven survival horror experience. Explore abandoned, atmospheric environments while being hunted by relentless Apes that react instantly, adapt to your behavior, and never stop once they've found you.

You run.
You climb.
You hide.

But once an Ape locks onto you, escape turns into a full-speed panic run where every movement decision matters.
